integrity: Exact formulas have a complete proof using the cited reachability characterization and a two-state Laurent transfer. Two standalone independent computations check exhaustive states and exchange edges through n=10 and transfer identities through n=30. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The component-connectivity criterion is prior work of Cereceda, van den Heuvel and Johnson; only the componentwise exact cardinality and edge enumeration and the assembled census are proposed as new. Applies to named proper 3-colourings and single-vertex recolourings of circular ladders. No mixing-time, diameter, or general product-graph theorem is claimed. Equivalent calculations might exist in historical height-function/Potts treatments; scholarly priority remains to be independently checked.
title: Exact winding-sector sizes and exchange counts for three-colourings of circular ladders
